text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
choice_data_list: Let's keep giving it our all once we get back to the academy!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "Yes. However, before that—I infer that Master has accumulated fatigue from the extended stay away from home."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: So, to express my gratitude, I will give Master a foot reflexology massage during the bus ride.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I'm confident in my skills.
I picked them up from a weekly magazine yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I'm confident in my acupressure and grip strength too.
Just the other day, I was able to crush an apple with one hand.

Reiterating that she was truly fine,
she politely declined once more.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The bus is about to leave.
Well then.
While seeing Mihono Bourbon off onto the bus—

Rice Shower came walking over slowly,
her clothes covered in mud.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Summer... I did everything. I gave it my all...
Next time, I'll definitely... catch up... No—"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Huh, ah! I'm sorry...!
Ouch, my clothes...

—And so, it seemed that summer
had come to an end for each of them.
